facts.fact: The AfCFTA Secretariat together with the Government of Nigeria closed the second AfCFTA Digital Trade Forum in Lagos on 2 July 2026, which adopted Eight Calls to Action; Nigeria's trade minister, as Chair of the AfCFTA Council of Ministers, reaffirmed Nigeria's role as co-champion of the Protocol on Digital Trade.
